name: e16-segment-lifetime

BODY.one_use: int far *p; p = makep(); return p[i];
BODY.two_uses: int far *p; p = makep(); return p[i] + p[i + 1];
BODY.two_uses_alias: int far *p; int far *q; p = makep(); q = p; return p[i] + q[i + 1];
BODY.call_between: int far *p; int v; p = makep(); v = p[i]; touch(); return v + p[i + 1];
